topics.purpose: Define exact relation from portfolio evidence to Project deliverables, artifacts and external work products without copying artifact ownership into PortfolioCore.

semantics.project_rule: Optional source Project identity is exact.
semantics.artifact_rule: Artifact/deliverable identity is exact where canonical; external URL is metadata/binding only.
semantics.ownership_rule: PortfolioCore references artifact/project evidence but does not become their semantic owner.
semantics.integrity_rule: Hash/revision metadata may identify exact artifact revision.
semantics.authority_rule: Link existence grants no artifact access beyond governance.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.

hard_gates.condition: URL changes create new competence identity automatically
